name: Digital Blood Pressure Monitor | Upper Arm Automatic BP Machine with Large LCD Display, Memory Storage & Voice Function
description:
Digital Blood Pressure Monitor | Upper Arm Automatic BP Machine with Large LCD Display, Memory Storage & Voice Function

The Digital Blood Pressure Monitor is an all-in-one, easy-to-use health monitoring device designed for accurate and reliable blood pressure measurement at home. Built with an advanced microcomputer intelligent system, it delivers precise readings of systolic pressure (SYS), diastolic pressure (DIA), and pulse rate within seconds. Featuring a large, clear LCD display and one-touch operation, this monitor is ideal for seniors, adults, and anyone who wants hassle-free daily monitoring. The voice function announces readings clearly, making it especially helpful for elderly users or individuals with weak eyesight. Its comfortable adjustable arm cuff and memory storage allow long-term tracking of blood pressure history with confidence.

Key Features:
Accurate Measurement Technology — Advanced microcomputer system for precise readings
Large LCD Digital Display — Easy-to-read SYS, DIA, pulse, date & time
Voice Function Support — Announces readings clearly for user convenience
One-Touch Operation — Simple start/stop button, no medical knowledge required
Memory Storage Function — Saves previous readings for tracking history
Comfortable Adjustable Arm Cuff — Ensures proper fit and accurate results
Automatic Inflation & Deflation — Fully automatic operation
Portable & Lightweight Design — Ideal for daily home use

Product Details:
Product Type: Electronic Digital Blood Pressure Monitor
Measurement Area: Upper Arm
Display Type: LCD Digital Screen with WHO Indicator
Measurement Method: Oscillometric
Voice Function: Yes
Units: mmHg (Blood Pressure) / BPM (Pulse Rate)
Cuff Size: Adjustable (Approx. 22–32 cm)
Memory Function: Stores multiple readings
Design: Compact, lightweight & portable
Usage: Home, elderly care & small clinics

Benefits:
Helps monitor blood pressure regularly at home
Reduces the need for frequent clinic visits
Easy to use for seniors and adults
Clear voice and display improve accessibility
Tracks health trends over time
Reliable and consistent measurement results

What’s in the Box:
1 × Electronic Digital Blood Pressure Monitor
1 × Adjustable Arm Cuff

Special Note:
Readings may vary slightly depending on body movement and positioning
Follow usage instructions for accurate results
